command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-shadow-runtime.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SHADOW=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html
OUT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v1_20260912_1100
BEFORE=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity/validate_shadow_blink_runtime.py" --visual-root visual --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9252 --cdp-port 9253
AFTER=$(sha256sum visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
o=Path('/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/.go_evidence/eye_shadow_runtime_v1_20260912_1100')
r=json.loads((o/'report.json').read_text())
print('RUNTIME_SUMMARY',json.dumps({'checks':r['checks'],'phases':r['phases'],'frame_count':len(r['frame_names']),'fps':r['raf']['fps'],'p95_ms':r['raf']['p95_ms'],'active_samples':r['active_sample_count']},sort_keys=True))
for p in sorted(o.glob('*.png')): print('PNG',p.name,p.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
sha256sum visual/buehne.html "$SHADOW"
